$comment: Desktop compatibility sweep round 7: the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1, the 30 of next30.json, the 30 of next30-round3.json, the 30 of next30-round4.json, the 30 of next30-round5.json and the 30 of next30-round6.json (ranks 181-210; the harness at /tmp/zen-compat reads this list; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round7/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures read 2026-09-22; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count, equal rounded rating counts by name. Candidates came from the store's category listings and keyword searches, about 12,360 detail pages probed across rounds 3 to 7 (this round added 115 search terms and 671 new detail pages, which surfaced one new 2,000,000 item, Snow Web Application Metering, an organisation-managed license-metering agent, not ranked). Every unmeasured item above the rounded 1,000,000 bucket is organisation-managed or organisation-login-only, so ranks 181-210 are the rounded 1,000,000 bucket's 30 rankable items with the most ratings after round 6's 27 (the cut falls between Google Analytics Opt-out Add-on at 1.5K and SEO META in 1 CLICK at 1.3K). Not ranked: themes (Morpheon Dark), Chrome Apps (Google Classroom), organisation-managed or organisation-login-only items (ClassLink OneClick, Clever, Mobility Print, Endpoint Verification, Lightspeed Insight Agent, Okta Browser Plugin, Trellix Endpoint Security Web Control, LearnPlatform for Students, OpenText Content Server Browser Web Extension, My Apps Secure Sign-in Extension, MasteryConnect LockDown Browser, HID Credential Management Extension, LanSchool Web Helper, iboss Cloud Connector, Snow Web Application Metering) and Google items whose detail pages publish no user count.
